name: Board Games
description: Board games word search puzzles gather cozy tabletop English — dice, token, turn, deck, draw, scorepad and evening — for adults who like play nights without naming commercial titles. Free online, with easy, medium, hard and large-print grids. No timer, no account and no licensed game brands: just the shared language of cards, boards and taking turns. Written for grown-up puzzlers and seniors who want a social theme that stays gentle on the eyes. Browse Chess for a focused strategy sibling, or Sports and Friendship when you want other group-activity hubs. See how to play if you are new, and use large print whenever letter size matters more than grid size.
